newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL PALM OIL ENDS STRONGER ON USDA REPORT, RINGGIT.
newsitem.headline: KL PALM OIL ENDS STRONGER ON USDA REPORT, RINGGIT.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Oct (3rd pos) 1,249 rgt/tonne Aug (south) 1,285
Open/Hi/Low 1,245/1,250/1,237 Prev close 1,275
Prev settlement 1,235 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Ended higher on a flurry of late speculative buying due to a further weakening of the ringgit and a positive USDA report. A major rally expected if the ringgit's level of 2.7 to a dollar touches 2.8. Fundamentals to matter when Ivan Wong releases his crop forecast on Thursday and PORLA and SGS their crop estimates on Friday. Immediate support seen at 1,230.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Limited activity with refiners' buying.
Another trader said rumours of Chinese interest in U.S. soyoil, along with the USDA report, had fuelled the market in early hours.
"There was good buying interest this morning. A good USDA report for soyoil helps the market," a trader said.
Dealers said a major rally could be seen on the market if the ringgit hit a historic low of 2.8 to a dollar.
"God knows what going to happen to the market at that stage," said another trader. "From the outset, it looks like there's going to be some fantastic buying."
On Wednesday, the ringgit was at 2.7780 to a dollar at 1000 GMT.
Physicals saw limited activity, with scattered buying among nearby months. Aug (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,285 ringgit against bids of 1,280. It was traded at 1,270 to 1,280.
August (central) saw offers at 1,270 against bids of 1,260.
Sept (south) was offered at 1,285 against bids of 1,280 and trades of between 1,275 and 1,280. Sept (central) saw offers at 1,275 against bids of 1,267.50 and trades of 1,260 to 1,265.
In refined palm oil, Aug RBD palm oil was offered at $492.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Sept at $490 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $487.50.
Sept RBD palm olein saw offers at $527.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $522.50. Sept was traded at $524 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $520.
Aug/Sept RBD palm stearin was offered $362.50 a tonne while Oct/Nov/Dec also saw offers at $362.50. Aug/Sept RBD palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $287.50.
At close, Malaysia's benchmark, October futures contract closed 14 ringgit up at 1,249 ringgit ($449.60) a tonne.
$1=2.7780 ringgit
